units.english: Hai power storage technology is thousands of years old, but remarkably simple and robust. This is the smallest Hai battery pack.
units.raw: description "Hai power storage technology is thousands of years old, but remarkably simple and robust. This is the smallest Hai battery pack."

units.english: This battery pack has more than three times the energy capacity of the Hai Chasm Batteries, allowing their ships to engage in combat for longer periods of time before running out of energy.
units.raw: description "This battery pack has more than three times the energy capacity of the Hai Chasm Batteries, allowing their ships to engage in combat for longer periods of time before running out of energy."

units.english: This medium-sized battery pack is ideal for most of the Hai power needs, allowing for medium length combat engagements, but could also be used keep a ship's heat footprint low with a small power generator and oversized engines.
units.raw: description "This medium-sized battery pack is ideal for most of the Hai power needs, allowing for medium length combat engagements, but could also be used keep a ship's heat footprint low with a small power generator and oversized engines."

units.english: This large battery pack boasts higher energy density than smaller models, and helps keep ships fighting in spite of sustaining several Ion Cannon impacts.
units.raw: description "This large battery pack boasts higher energy density than smaller models, and helps keep ships fighting in spite of sustaining several Ion Cannon impacts."

units.english: While most Hai ships do not employ their largest battery model, a few very powerful warships are occasionally equipped with one, keeping their heat footprint low, and allowing them to survive longer in a fight against opponents carrying Ion Cannons.
units.raw: description "While most Hai ships do not employ their largest battery model, a few very powerful warships are occasionally equipped with one, keeping their heat footprint low, and allowing them to survive longer in a fight against opponents carrying Ion Cannons."

units.english: The Hai designed these miniaturized fusion generators back when their territory was being raided by the Korath. In these relatively peaceful times, they have seen no need to update the design.
units.raw: description "The Hai designed these miniaturized fusion generators back when their territory was being raided by the Korath. In these relatively peaceful times, they have seen no need to update the design."

units.english: Fission reactors are considered a rudimentary technology among interstellar species. Nonetheless, it remains a proven and safe technology that even the Hai use fairly regularly.
units.raw: description "Fission reactors are considered a rudimentary technology among interstellar species. Nonetheless, it remains a proven and safe technology that even the Hai use fairly regularly."

units.english: A Pebble Core is a miniaturized nuclear reactor, small enough to be installed in any ship larger than a fighter. The Hai developed this model for their smaller ships.
units.raw: description "A Pebble Core is a miniaturized nuclear reactor, small enough to be installed in any ship larger than a fighter. The Hai developed this model for their smaller ships."

units.english: The Sand Cell is the smallest Hai generator. It was designed for ships which don't need or are unable to carry a nuclear reactor, and it clearly resembles human fuel cells.
units.raw: description "The Sand Cell is the smallest Hai generator. It was designed for ships which don't need or are unable to carry a nuclear reactor, and it clearly resembles human fuel cells."

units.english: While the Hai were designing the Flea, it quickly became apparent that even the "Basrem" engine set was too large for the purpose. As a result, a combined thruster steering set was created: "Baellie."
units.raw: description `While the Hai were designing the Flea, it quickly became apparent that even the "Basrem" engine set was too large for the purpose. As a result, a combined thruster steering set was created: "Baellie."`

units.english: Unbeknownst to the scientists of the Deep, the Hai have been using atomic engine technology for many millennia. Hai atomic engines are still much more energy hungry than other engines, but exhibit greater efficiency than their human counterparts.
units.raw: description "Unbeknownst to the scientists of the Deep, the Hai have been using atomic engine technology for many millennia. Hai atomic engines are still much more energy hungry than other engines, but exhibit greater efficiency than their human counterparts."

units.english: Unlike human space where atomic engines are a rare sight to see and a luxury to have, many years of being confined to a relatively small pocket of the Galaxy has allowed all Hai ships to be outfitted with atomic engines.
units.raw: description "Unlike human space where atomic engines are a rare sight to see and a luxury to have, many years of being confined to a relatively small pocket of the Galaxy has allowed all Hai ships to be outfitted with atomic engines."

units.english: This thruster is the standard thruster on most Hai light warships, providing enough thrust to make them usable in combat, but it is not quite big enough to suffice for something as large as a Hai Shield Beetle.
units.raw: description "This thruster is the standard thruster on most Hai light warships, providing enough thrust to make them usable in combat, but it is not quite big enough to suffice for something as large as a Hai Shield Beetle."
